title: Single adult human lung cells self-construct into motile multicellular biobots

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Single adult human lung cells self-construct into motile multicellular biobots

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: A single normal human bronchial epithelial cell from adult lung, cultured in extracellular matrix for two weeks and then transferred to a low-viscosity medium, self-constructs into a multicellular, motile spheroid (an Anthrobot) without genetic editing, scaffolds or manual sculpting.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Gumuskaya G 2024, Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells › Abstract

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: Each Anthrobot begins as a single cell, derived from the adult human lung, and self‐constructs into a multicellular motile biobot after being cultured in extra cellular matrix for 2 weeks and transferred into a minimally viscous habitat.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Gumuskaya G, Srivastava P, Cooper BG, Lesser H, Semegran B, Garnier S, Levin M, “Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells”, Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany) (2024), doi:10.1002/advs.202303575; section “Abstract”. Scope: Normal human bronchial epithelial (NHBE) progenitor cells from adult donors, in vitro

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2024-anthrobots-01: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.80

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The protocol and phenotype map directly to observable variables, and public supporting media permit substantial checking. Full yield, clonality, and exclusion of selection effects require records beyond selected public examples.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Audit time-lapse and lineage/protocol records for single seeded NHBE cells, quantifying clonal spheroid growth and subsequent cilia-driven displacement without editing, scaffolding, or sculpting.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Matrigel is an extracellular matrix even though it is not a permanent scaffold.

Complete single-cell lineage movies and all culture failures may not be public.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
operationalizability: 0.97
data adequacy: 0.62
analysis feasibility: 0.86
data existence: 0.72
discriminating power: 0.88

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Single-cell origin, multicellularity and motility are ordinary counts and tracks. The 2024 paper's own data-availability statement keeps the underlying measurements with the authors, and the public videos are illustrations rather than the cohort. Checking the result means a new run of the protocol or release of the withheld logs, not analysis of an existing open file.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Start from single dissociated adult normal human bronchial epithelial cells, culture them in matrix for two weeks, move the products to low-viscosity medium, and score multicellularity and motility without added genes, scaffolds or sculpting. Clonal spheroids that translocate would support the protocol result; aggregates that require many seed cells, or that remain immotile, would refute the single-cell self-construction claim.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Supplementary videos illustrate motility; they do not show that each spheroid began as one cell.

Donor and batch replication counts are not in an open table.

The paper states that the supporting data are available from the authors on request, not in a public archive.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
operationalizability: 0.9
analysis feasibility: 0.22
data adequacy: 0.18
discriminating power: 0.5
data existence: 0.22
